Crow.reason: “Crow” is part of the story title “The Thirsty Crow,” not a language name; therefore false_positive.

Sar.reason: “Sar” is the first element of the transliterated Urdu title “Sar Kaṭā Sawār” (“The Headless Horseman”), not a language name; therefore false_positive.

Hindi.reason: Hindi is the language paired with Devanagari intrusion and analyzed as cross-script leakage in generated Urdu; it is part of the paper’s error evaluation, so studied.

Latin.reason: Latin denotes the Latin script in “Latin Script Intrusion” and “Latin-script English words,” not the Latin language; therefore false_positive.

Punjabi.reason: Punjabi is a human language whose phrases are identified as mixed into otherwise Urdu narratives and treated as an error pattern; therefore studied.

Urdu.reason: Urdu is the target language of the generated story corpus and the LLM evaluation; therefore studied.

Persian.reason: Persian is named only in comparison with Urdu’s retroflex phonemes; no Persian data or evaluation is shown, so mentioned_only.

Arabic.reason: Arabic is mentioned in connection with an Arabic loanword and in comparison with Urdu phonology, but no Arabic corpus or evaluation is shown; therefore mentioned_only.

Chinese.reason: Chinese is the language of lexical intrusions embedded in generated Urdu and analyzed in the script-contamination evaluation; therefore studied.

English.reason: English is used for a control corpus and comparison and analyzed in English-mediated errors and English-word intrusions; therefore studied.
